# QUESTIONs with `tags` `social-ontology`

*Topics — What a work is about. Nucleation holds whatever reading the owner files here, whether or not an Anthology of the SOTA topic could also hold it; instruction for ML practice belongs to the anthology (ADR-048). The words are seeded from the clusters the reading-time triage of 2026-09-25 found, and grow by decision.*

**Social ontology** — what social facts, groups, institutions and social kinds are, and what makes them exist — collective intentionality, joint commitment, status functions, convention, social construction, and whether groups can be agents or minds (group: philosophy; ADR-017).

| [QUESTION-296](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-296.md) | Can an intervention on what an interpreter is told about a communicative situation tell the relations that constitute the act from those that only accompany it? | The part of [QUESTION-030](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-030.md)'s empirical half that [CLAIM-130](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-130.md) settles, split off by the status review of 2026-10-28 under [ADR-049](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-049.md).
